Name: (CP) Junimos as Farm Animals

Description:
[center]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of my assets and code (note some assets of this mod are [b]not[/b] mine - I am only granting permission for the work that is my own). I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.

[b][size=6]Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I purchase Junimos as livestock?
[/b][/size]Like other livestock, you can purchase them from Marnie's Ranch!

[size=4][b]What kind of Junimos are there?
[/b][/size]There are currently 24 colors of Junimo! Each one will drop a random seasonal crop each day.

[size=4][b]
What crops are dropped?
[/b][/size]All seasonal crops are dropped at random! Deluxe drops include crops that are generally worth more or are hard to get (such as Red Cabbage, Ancient Fruit, etc).

[size=4][b]Is this mod configurable?
[/b][/size][size=2]Yes! You can configure the mod (I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]). You can activate each color of Junimo individually. By default, only green Junimos are present. As of [i]version 2.0.0[/i], you can also enable/disable Random Color Purchase. When enabled, purchased Junimos will be a random color out of the enabled Junimo Colors config. When disabled, each enabled color will be an individual animal listing in Marnie's Ranch.

[i]Warning: if changing Random Color Purchase in the middle of a save, it is advised to sell your Junimos and then update your config before reloading your save. Otherwise, error sprites may be applied to your Junimos.[/i]

Downloads.Description:
Adds 12 new colors to the color palette, courtesy of thefangirlotaku.

Adds option in config to enable/disable random color purchasing of Junimos from Marnie's Ranch. You may now explicitly choose which color to purchase if disabled.
